inputs.name: web_password
inputs.description: Password of the web interface's nagiosadmin user. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_web_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: web_listen_address
inputs.description: Address the web server listens on. The default keeps Nagios on the host, for a proxy or an SSH tunnel. Anything else sends the login in the clear, since the circuit doesn't set up TLS.

inputs.name: web_port
inputs.description: Port the web server listens on.

inputs.name: monitored_hosts
inputs.description: Hosts Nagios watches, by name, such as { web1 = { address = "10.0.0.5" } }. check_command is how Nagios decides the host is up, by default a ping.

inputs.name: services
inputs.type:
map(object({
    host               = string
    check_command      = string
    description        = optional(string)
    check_interval     = optional(number, 5)
    retry_interval     = optional(number, 1)
    max_check_attempts = optional(number, 3)
  }))
inputs.description: Services Nagios checks, by name, such as { web1_http = { host = "web1", description = "HTTP", check_command = "check_http" } }. description defaults to the name, and intervals are in minutes.

inputs.name: commands
inputs.description: Extra check commands, by name, such as { check_api = "$USER1$/check_http -H $HOSTADDRESS$ -u /health" }. They run on the Nagios host as the nagios user.

inputs.name: extra_objects
inputs.description: More Nagios object definitions, added to the file as they are, such as contacts or host groups. nagios -v checks them before any reload.

inputs.name: nagios_version
inputs.description: Nagios Core release to build on Ubuntu, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux and RHEL. Debian and Fedora use their own package, whatever its version. Change it together with nagios_sha256.

inputs.name: nagios_sha256
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the nagios_version source tarball.
